title: Target anatomy
view: Transverse section of the right mid-forearm, palm up, as on the screen: radial (thumb side) on the image left, ulnar on the right, volar skin at the top - as the median plates.
teachingPoint: The radial nerve sits directly lateral to the radial artery in the same fascial plane under brachioradialis; needle in-plane from lateral, spread around the nerve.
claims: Right forearm in section, radial on the left (house laterality; NYSORA's plate mirrored, concept only).
Radial nerve directly lateral to the radial artery, same fascial plane (record).
Needle in-plane from the lateral (radial) end, tip at the nerve's lateral border, the artery beyond it (record: in-plane; side as NYSORA).
Teal: spread around the nerve (record: circumferential).
Standard anatomy added: brachioradialis over the plane, ECR, FCR, pronator teres, FPL, radius.
Labels: Radial nerve, Radial artery, Brachioradialis, Pronator teres, Radius.
